Done. The 12-layer checkpoint is written to `out/T1/model.safetensors` with 86 tensors, produced by a single successful execution of `out/T1/solution.py`.

The script loads both shards via safetensors, drops blocks 2, 6, 10, 14, and builds a fresh output dictionary with the renumbered names, so there is no in-place move and no collision hazard. Before saving it enforces the required checks and exits non-zero without writing if any fails:

- No block 12 to 15 remains, and the block set is exactly 0 to 11.
- Exactly 12 q_proj tensors and exactly 86 tensors in total.
- Every surviving tensor is bit-identical in shape, dtype, and values to its source.

Tools used were safetensors 0.5.3 and torch 2.14.0 only. A plain script was chosen over mergekit or torch-state-bridge because the mapping is fixed and small, and explicit checks are simpler to verify than tool configuration. The self-report is in `out/T1/REPORT.md`.
